changes.summary: Block the full PostgreSQL server-side file reader family in BiChat SQL validation.
Add Go-declared module-local Solid screens with generated TypeScript bindings, lazy catalog hosting, and build/watch tooling.
Add a public SolidJS UI component library with the canonical iota-sdk visual contract, shared portal support, and deterministic browser visual regression coverage.

Add spreadsheet-safe CSV export to pkg/excel (CSVExporter, CSVWriter, NeutralizeFormula) and the excel.Formula cell type; plain values never open as formulas in CSV or XLSX, and the CRM client CSV export uses the new writer.
Show the checkmark on checked templ checkboxes under Tailwind v4 and align the Solid UI check glyph with it.
